name: Teva Pharmaceutical Industries Limited
blurb: Teva Pharmaceutical Industries is a global pharmaceutical company specializing in generic and specialty medicines, with a growing focus on neuroscience and innovative therapies. Headquartered in Israel, it is one of the world's largest generic drug manufacturers. The company has been pivoting toward higher-margin specialty drugs, including its schizophrenia treatment UZEDY, to offset challenges in its generics business.
recent: In late April 2026, Teva reported strong Q1 results with sales of $3.98 billion and net income of $369 million, beating expectations. The stock rose 14.1% following the earnings release, driven by improved profitability and the planned acquisition of Emalex Biosciences to bolster its neuroscience pipeline.
